New primitives test group for ordered delivery and its signal/event adoption.
New scalar test group for command lifecycle.

Documentation examples after removing the adapter helper.

New collections test group for ordered emission (relations).

tasks.title: Make DeliveryQueue panic-safe
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add an unwind guard to `DeliveryQueue`'s drain loop (`crates/src/primitives/delivery.rs`) so a subscriber panic clears the `delivering` flag; queued items are delivered by the next push/drain and the panic still propagates. Create the primitives test module (`crates/src/primitives/tests/mod.rs`, registered with `#[cfg(test)] mod tests;` in `primitives/mod.rs`) and the new group `panic_safe_delivery.rs` covering a bare queue plus `Signal`, `EventBus`, `SourceList` and `SourceCache` end to end (catch the panic with `std::panic::catch_unwind`, then verify old and new subscribers keep receiving). Update chapter 16's panic section (the stall is gone) and its doc example if any.

tasks.title: Commit-ordered push/drain, ordered subscriber registry
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement D-DELIVERY in `crates/src/primitives/delivery.rs`: additive `push`/`drain`, `enqueue = push + drain`, subscription-ordered registry with `u64` ids and a shared `Arc` snapshot rebuilt only on subscribe/unsubscribe, per-entry `active` flag cleared by `Subscription` disposal and checked before each call, and a backlog accessor. Adopt push-under-lock/drain-after-unlock in `Signal::set/replace/update` (`crates/src/signal.rs`) and `EventBus::emit` (`crates/src/event.rs`). Add the group `crates/src/primitives/tests/ordered_delivery.rs` (multi-thread push order, deterministic subscriber order, `cfg(test)` snapshot rebuild counter, disposal during delivery, 4-thread signal writers over 200 rounds asserting strictly increasing versions and final-value convergence, backlog accessor). Update chapters 4 and 16 (ordering, subscriber order, disposal, draining-thread behavior) and their examples.

tasks.title: Truthful command lifecycle and execution policy
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the command part of D-SCALAR in `crates/src/command.rs`: per-execution generations so only the latest execution publishes its terminal state, an in-flight counter behind additive `is_executing() -> ReadSignal<bool>`, a drop guard in `AsyncCommand::execute` that publishes `Cancelled` when the future is dropped mid-flight, a panic guard publishing `Failed` with a panic message and re-raising, disabled calls that publish nothing, and additive `ExecutionPolicy::{Concurrent, IgnoreWhileRunning}` constructors. Create the scalar test module `crates/src/scalar_tests/mod.rs` (registered in `lib.rs` as `#[cfg(test)] mod scalar_tests;`) and the group `command_lifecycle.rs` (drop after one poll via a manual waker or `futures::poll!`, overlapping runs, disabled calls, panics, policy). Update chapter 6 and its examples.

tasks.title: Glitch-free, fresh and cheaper Computed
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the computed part of D-SCALAR in `crates/src/computed.rs`: version-tuple re-read in `drain_combine`/`drain_derive` (relies on subscription-order delivery from t02), lazy staleness check in `get()`/read handles, single evaluation at construction when the second snapshot is unchanged, unwind-safe `processing` flags, and additive `combine3` and `derive_distinct`. Group `crates/src/scalar_tests/computed_consistency.rs`: diamond over 100 trials, `combine2(a, a)`, cross-thread `get()` freshness (hold another thread in a slow subscriber), construction evaluation count and version 0, panic recovery, new constructors. Update chapter 3 (remove the "equal results are still published" caveat only where `derive_distinct` applies; document glitch freedom).

tasks.title: Robust signals and non-blocking reads
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the signal part of D-SCALAR in `crates/src/signal.rs` and `crates/src/primitives/stream.rs`: per-subscriber version gate for `values()`, unwind-safe `update`/`set`/`replace` (restore previous value, clear poison), clone reduction (`mem::replace`, no change construction without subscribers), additive `try_get`/`try_read` on `Signal` and `ReadSignal`, and `start_with` that subscribes upstream first. Group `crates/src/scalar_tests/signal_robustness.rs` with a cloning probe type, a forced cross-thread interleaving test hook, panic tests, and the `start_with` write-in-callback test. Update chapters 3, 4 and 16.

tasks.title: Truthful activation and scoped registrations
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the activation part of D-SCALAR in `crates/src/activation.rs`: generation phases, additive `ViewModelActivator::is_active()` and `ActivationToken::is_active()`, scoped registrations dropped with their generation (additive API), and disposal of partial work when a live `when_activated` registration fails. Group `crates/src/scalar_tests/activation_lifecycle.rs` (concurrent activate during a slow first activation that fails, nested registration counts across four activations, partial-work disposal). Update chapter 5.

tasks.title: Error-generic streams and collection-to-scalar errors
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement D-INTEROP's primitive and scalar parts: `ValueStream::map_err`/`err_into` (`crates/src/primitives/stream.rs`), `ReactiveValueStreamExt<T, E = ReactiveError>` for every `E` (`crates/src/stream_ext.rs`), `Effect::watch` over `ValueStream<T, E>` (`crates/src/effect.rs`), `OptionValueStreamExt` generic over `E` (`crates/src/collections/option/option_value_stream_ext.rs`), `ReactiveError::External` (`crates/src/primitives/error.rs`) with `impl From<CollectionError> for ReactiveError` in `crates/src/collections/error.rs`, and an additive stream-to-state conversion (`ValueStream::to_signal` or `Computed::from_stream`). Group `crates/src/scalar_tests/stream_error_interop.rs` (including `?` on a collection subscription inside `when_activated`, `Effect::watch` on a collection `count()`, and a command enabled by a collection count). Record the breaking variant in the changelog draft notes for t45.

tasks.title: Collection operators accept any convertible stream error
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Change every collection operator parameter listed in INT-2.1 to accept `crate::primitives::ValueStream<_, E>` with `CollectionError: From<E>` (following `filter_with_state`), converting internally with `err_into`; touch the trait declarations in `operators/predicate.rs`, `operators/cache_stream_ext.rs`, `lifecycle/{list,cache}.rs`, `aggregation/cache_aggregation_ext.rs`, `true_for/`, `tree/stream_ext.rs`, `switch.rs`, `populate/`, `diff.rs`, `stream/batch_count_state.rs`, and their impls. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/operator_input_interop/` with a compile-and-run test passing `Signal::values()` to each operator plus a test that existing collection-flavor call sites still compile. Remove the `collection_stream` helper from README and docs, rewrite chapter 15's interop section, and keep `cargo test -p rayx_reactive_doc_examples` green.

tasks.title: ValueStream combinators
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add the INT-3.1 operators to `crates/src/stream_ext.rs` (generic over `E`): `merge`, `combine_latest`, `switch_map`, `scan`, `take`, `first`, `take_until`, `pairwise`, `with_latest_from`, `distinct_until_changed_by`, `share` (with optional replay of the latest value). Each operator owns and disposes its inner/upstream subscriptions. Group `crates/src/scalar_tests/value_stream_combinators.rs` covering order and disposal for each. Document them in chapter 4 with executable examples.

sprints.title: Source locking, ordering, suspension and reads

tasks.title: Owner-aware source lock with native blocking and wasm non-blocking policy
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement D-SOURCE-LOCK: a crate-internal source lock (for example `collections/source_lock.rs`) that records the owning `ThreadId` during edits and key-selector calls, returns `NestedUpdate` for same-thread re-entry, blocks on native and returns the new `CollectionError::Contended` on `wasm32`, with a `cfg(test)` switch forcing the non-blocking policy on native. Route every state access of `SourceList` (`list/list_state.rs`), `SourceCache` (`cache/source_cache_impl.rs`), `RayCacheGroup` (`group.rs`) and `RayListGroup` (`list_group.rs`) through it, including reads, `connect`, `lookup`, `watch*`, `suspend_notifications` and `count_changed` setup. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/source_lock_policy/` (4-thread writers, reader-plus-writer, every same-thread re-entry entry point with a deadlock watchdog thread, non-blocking policy contention without partial registrations). Update chapters 8 and 16 and the sources memory rules note in the changelog draft.

tasks.title: Commit-ordered source publication and count streams
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the ordering part of D-SOURCE-PUBLISH: sources push `preview`, `changes` and `count_changed` items under the state lock using t02's `push` and drain after unlocking; `count_changed` subscribes before reading its baseline. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/source_commit_order/` (4 threads × 2,000 edits over 20 rounds with strictly increasing versions and a converging `as_observable_list` mirror; edit inside a `preview` callback; count updates in the initial callback and concurrently).

tasks.title: Versioned suspension segments
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the suspension part of D-SOURCE-PUBLISH: store suspended changes as `(version, changes)` segments; on resume publish one public `ChangeSet` whose crate-private `VersionedChangeSet` carries segment boundaries; teach `StartupConnection` (`connection.rs`) and the keyed hub (`keyed_delivery.rs`) to drop segments covered by their snapshot version. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/suspension_versions/` with the list `[0,1,2,1]`, cache wrong-row and `watch(5)` duplicate repros for both source types.

tasks.title: Updater reads and point queries
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add read access to `ListUpdater` (`items`, `len`, `is_empty`, `get`) and `CacheUpdater` (`lookup`, `contains_key`, `count`, `keys`), and additive point queries and zero-clone reads (`SourceList::get/contains/read`, `SourceCache::contains_key/read`, the same on `ObservableList`/`ObservableCache`, `SourceCache::from_items`). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/source_read_api/` (in-edit visibility, 4-thread read-modify-write counter with no lost updates, each new query). Update chapter 8 (remove the "updaters are write-only" note).

tasks.title: One watch value per batch
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Fold each batch per key before emitting from `watch_value`/`watch_optional` (sources, observable caches and `CacheStreamExt` watches) and forward only the watched key's part of a `Clear` from `watch(key)`. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/watch_batch_coalescing/` (`load` keeping the key, add+update+remove in one edit, `Clear` with other keys). Update chapter 8's watch table and example.

sprints.title: Materialization, ref_count and switch that never lose batches

tasks.title: Pending FIFO and error reporting for materializers
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement D-MATERIALIZE for `populate_into`, `populate_from*`, every `to_*_change_set*` bridge, `ObservableList`/`ObservableCache::from_stream` and the source limit helpers: replace every `let _ = destination.edit(..)` with a pending FIFO applied before the next batch and an additive error stream (`errors()` on the wrappers, `populate_into_with_errors`). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/materialization_reliability/` using t10's non-blocking policy switch to force contention and asserting convergence and reported errors. Update chapter 14.

tasks.title: Reliable ref_count startup and teardown
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the `ref_count` part of D-MATERIALIZE in `crates/src/collections/ref_count.rs`: rollback on failed upstream start, per-subscriber startup buffer with a local sequence number, upstream epochs. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/ref_count_lifecycle/` (failure then retry, late subscriber with a concurrent publisher receiving its snapshot first over many rounds, last-unsubscribe race leaving no stale state).

tasks.title: Reliable switch
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Implement the `switch` part of D-MATERIALIZE in `crates/src/collections/switch.rs` (all four receivers): report and retry inner subscribe failures, `disposed` flag, ordered output re-checking the generation at dequeue (may use t18's emitter if already present; otherwise a local `DeliveryQueue` push/drain). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/switch_reliability/` (failing inner under the non-blocking policy, stale-generation batches from another thread, dispose racing an outer emission).

tasks.title: Ordered emitter and its adoption by filters, sorts, windows and groups
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Create the crate-internal ordered emitter (D-EMIT, for example `crates/src/collections/emit.rs`) and route through it every operator named in EMT-1.1, plus list `virtualize` and `reverse`, which today call the subscriber under their own locks. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/ordered_emission_core/`: for each operator family, a two-thread test (dynamic input on one thread, source edits on another) over 200 rounds comparing the final view with a naive recomputation, plus a concurrency probe asserting the subscriber is never entered twice at once.

tasks.title: Ordered emission for joins, combiners, trees, forced transforms and merge-many
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Route every operator named in EMT-1.2 through t18's emitter: `join/*`, `combine/*`, forced transforms (`operators/cache_inline_transform_state.rs`, `cache_async_safe_job.rs`, `start_cache_async_transform_many_child.rs`), `tree/stream_ext.rs` with predicates, and `merge_many_*_change_sets` in `lifecycle/`. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/ordered_emission_relations/` including the two-thread `full_join` inversion repro and per-family convergence tests.

sprints.title: Cache index contract: harness, keyed sort, subsets, snapshot diffs

tasks.title: Document the index contract and build the contract harness
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Document the `CacheChange` (and `ListChange`) index contract in `crates/src/collections/change.rs` rustdoc per D-INDEX. Add shared test support (for example `crates/src/collections/tests/support/contract.rs`): strict list/cache mirrors that apply changes in order and reject out-of-range or inconsistent indexes, and a deterministic differential fuzzer (in-crate xorshift PRNG, random batches of add/update/remove/move/refresh/clear/indexed upserts, naive recomputation oracle). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/index_contract_harness/` self-tests the validator against malformed sequences and runs the list operators named in IDX-1.1 over 300 seeds. Later index tasks reuse this support in their own groups.

tasks.title: Keyed sort position maps and binary-search insertion
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Fix `insert_order_key` in `crates/src/collections/operators/cache_sort_state_impl.rs` to refresh positions from `min(existing, index)` (as `move_order_key` does), add debug assertions that maps match vectors, and switch sparse insertion to binary search while keeping the indexed-keyed-sort decision's tie and 64-entry batch semantics. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/keyed_sort_positions/`: both audit repros, chained sorts, 300 fuzz seeds with indexed upserts through `sort_keyed_*`, cache `sort_*`, `top_keyed`, `update_index`, and a comparer-call counter at n = 10,000.

tasks.title: Output-space indexes for subset and inline operators
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Make cache `filter` keep its own output order (no spurious `Remove`/`Clear` for never-included keys), make `filter_immutable*`, `transform_safe*` and forced transforms emit output-space indexes or `None`, fix the dynamic filter's `Move`+`Update` (`cache_dynamic_filter_state_impl.rs`), make `transform_inline*` preserve positional updates (`list_sort_state.rs` `CacheInlineTransformState`), and harden the cache-to-list bridge (`apply_list_changes.rs` `CacheRemoveKeyState`) to fall back to key positions on disagreement. Update the existing test `transforms_filters/cache_filter_and_transform_emit_keyed_changes.rs` that pins a source-space index. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/subset_operator_indexes/` with the audit repros and fuzzer coverage for each operator.

tasks.title: Snapshot, join and combiner diffs follow the contract
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Fix `Move`+`Update` index pairs in `operators/diff_cache_snapshots.rs`, `join/join_state.rs`, `join/affected_key.rs`, `combine/cache_key_updates.rs` and `limit/diff_limited_cache.rs`; compute `previous_index` after removals in `operators/ungrouped_cache_state.rs` and `tree/stream_ext.rs`; make join output order follow the left/combined source order without out-of-range moves. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/snapshot_diff_indexes/` with the G-2/G-5/G-8 repros and fuzzer runs for keyed windows, joins, immutable groups and trees (300 seeds each).

sprints.title: Groups, key bridges, keyed state and windows

tasks.title: Group indexes, group_by order and combiner updates
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Shift later pending group `Add` indexes when a pending `Add` is dropped (or emit adds after finalization) in `operators/list_pending_group_changes.rs` and `operators/immutable_cache_group_entry.rs` without breaking the sparse-live-group decision; order cache `group_by` members by an ordered key mirror and handle `Clear { previous: [] }`; keep `preferred` values when an `Update` and `Refresh` merge in `combine/cache_key_updates.rs` (static and dynamic). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/group_and_combiner_indexes/` with repros and fuzzer runs.

tasks.title: add_key, ensure_unique_keys and ValueStream edit_diff
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Make `add_key` (`operators/diff_cache_snapshots.rs`) emit list-consistent indexes on add/remove/move (or none), rebuild `ensure_unique_keys` emission from its own order and forward surviving `Move`s (`operators/select_unique_cache_changes.rs`, `push_child_adds.rs`), and reimplement `ValueStream` `edit_diff*` (`crates/src/collections/diff.rs`) on an ordered private state with sequentially valid indexes and last-occurrence duplicate policy. Update the pinned test in `aggregation_diagnostics_diff/value_stream_snapshot_edit_diff_emits_list_changes.rs` (or the keyed equivalent) and note it for the changelog. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/key_bridge_indexes/`.

tasks.title: Stateful change_key, deterministic transform_many, merge-many generations
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Make `change_key`/`change_key_with_source_key` track source→destination keys with collision reference counts (`operators/push_child_adds.rs`, `cache_stream_ext_impl.rs`); rebuild sync cache `transform_many` on the async variant's ordered first-live-parent state (`cache_async_transform_many_state.rs`); add generation tokens or last-wins start deduplication to cache-parent `merge_many_*_change_sets` (`lifecycle/cache.rs`). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/keyed_state_operators/` with the T-7, T-8 and L-6 repros and fuzzer runs.

tasks.title: Current response totals, request-gated list windows, correct sort_and_page
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Emit page/virtual responses whenever response fields change (empty change set allowed) and an initial response once loaded, for list (`list_stream_ext_impl.rs`), keyed (`keyed_cache_page_state.rs`) and `sort_and_*` (`cache_sorted_page_state.rs`) variants; start list dynamic windows without a request; rebuild `sort_and_page_*`/`sort_and_virtualize_*` on `CacheSortState` plus window diffing (or apply removals before reinsertion with an incrementally maintained position map) so results match `sort_keyed_*` + keyed window. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/window_responses/` (totals changing outside the window, empty initial window, W-1, fuzzer equivalence, comparer-call count for an 8,000-item load). Update chapter 10 (remove the stale-totals warning).

tasks.title: Scheduler, ThreadScheduler and ManualScheduler
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `crates/src/primitives/scheduler.rs` per D-TIME: the `Scheduler` trait (`now`, `schedule(delay, task) -> ScheduledTask` with cancel-on-drop), `ThreadScheduler` (one lazily started timer thread per instance with condvar waits and cancellation, plus a process-wide default), and `ManualScheduler` (virtual clock, `advance_by`, deterministic ordering of due tasks). Export from the primitives prelude. Group `crates/src/primitives/tests/scheduler.rs` (ordering, cancellation, many timers on one thread via a `cfg(test)` spawn counter, manual clock). Document in chapter 16 how a wasm application supplies its own scheduler.

tasks.title: Timed stream controls on the scheduler
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rebuild `batch`, `buffer_initial`, `batch_if_with_timeout`/`buffer_if_with_timeout` (`stream/batch_count_state.rs`, `stream/flush_initial_buffer.rs`) and list/cache `auto_refresh_buffered` (`lifecycle/list.rs`, `lifecycle/cache.rs`) on the scheduler with additive `*_with_scheduler` variants, cancel-on-dispose without joins, immediate release of buffers and subscribers, and emission through t18's emitter (no new timer while a flush runs). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/timed_stream_controls/` using `ManualScheduler` (deterministic flushes, disposal from inside a timer callback, no emission after dispose) plus a real-thread stress for ordering and refresh-index validity.

tasks.title: Expiration on the scheduler
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rebuild every `expire_after*` (`expiration/*`, adapter options in `populate/`) on the scheduler: fix polling waits, translate/normalize later changes in stream expiration, compute due items inside the source edit closure with requeue-on-failure and actual-removal reporting, and compact stale queue entries. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/expiration_rework/` on `ManualScheduler` for L-1, L-2 and L-15, plus a real-thread concurrent-editor test for L-5 (0 of 400 missed). Update chapter 14's expiration section. Finally confirm by review (TIM-1.5) that `thread::spawn`, `Instant::now` and `SystemTime::now` in time-based operators now live only in `ThreadScheduler` and the `diagnostics` timestamps.

tasks.title: Incremental stream size limit
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rewrite stream `limit_size_to` (`limit/cache_limit_ext.rs`, `limit/diff_limited_cache.rs`) with an incremental sequence-ordered structure that forwards `Refresh` and same-value `Update` for retained keys; the source limiters adopt t30's inside-edit validation. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/limit_size_rework/` with the L-8 repro and a cloning-probe cost test.

tasks.title: debounce, throttle and sample
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `debounce`, `throttle` and `sample` for `ValueStream<T, E>` in `crates/src/stream_ext.rs`, taking a `Scheduler` with default-scheduler conveniences; disposal cancels pending timers. Group `crates/src/scalar_tests/timed_value_stream_operators.rs` on `ManualScheduler`. Document in chapter 4.

tasks.title: Bounded workers, cancellation and panic isolation for cache async transforms
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Rebuild cache `transform_async*`/`transform_safe_async*` (`cache_transform_async_stream.rs`) and `transform_many_async*`/`*_async_stream*` (`start_cache_async_transform_many_child.rs`, `cache_transform_many_*`) per D-ASYNC: bounded per-subscription workers honoring `TransformAsyncOptions` (new `_with_options` variants for transform-many), `Abortable` futures cancelled on dispose and key removal/update, `catch_unwind` per future, `Some(0)` treated as 1, output through t18's emitter; apply the same cancellation and panic isolation to list `transform_async*` (`list_transform_stream.rs`). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/async_transform_workers/` (2,000 parents with a `cfg(test)` thread counter, slow-subscriber stale-child check, cancellation with a pending future, panicking future).

tasks.title: List transform_async_with_options
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add list `transform_async_with_options` running a batch's futures concurrently up to the limit and applying results in index order (`list_transform_stream.rs`), and drop the unused `U: PartialEq` bound from list async transforms. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/list_async_transform_options/` with the 20 non-contiguous inserts timing test (generous bound) and ordering checks.

tasks.title: Panic-isolated async disposal
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Wrap each `async_dispose_many*` finalizer future in `catch_unwind` (`lifecycle/cache.rs` worker) so later finalizers run and completion always fires. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/async_dispose_hardening/`.

tasks.title: Non-flickering emptiness and robust numeric aggregates
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Fix `is_empty`/`is_not_empty` (list `aggregation/cache_query.rs`, cache `aggregation/cache_aggregation_ext.rs`) to derive the initial value from the first count and deduplicate; use compensated sums with recompute on non-finite/large removals for `sum_by`/`avg_by`/`std_dev_by` (keeping the DynamicData std-dev formula rule); total-order NaN handling in `max_by`/`min_by`/`distinct_values`. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/aggregate_robustness/`. Update chapters 7 and 13.

tasks.title: Lifecycle edge cases
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: List `dispose_many` same-item skip and additive list `dispose_many_by` (`lifecycle/list.rs`); emit `collect_update_stats` outside its lock (`diagnostics.rs`); subscribe `true_for_*` children before evaluating (`true_for/`); coalesce synchronous child emissions at startup and on same-children parent updates in `filter_on_observable` and merge-many (`lifecycle/`). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/lifecycle_semantics/` (requires the `diagnostics` feature, which the check enables).

tasks.title: Source bookkeeping and clone costs
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Per D-PERF in `cache/source_cache_impl.rs`, `cache/cache_notification_suspension.rs`, `list/list_state.rs` and `keyed_delivery.rs`: maintain or lazily rebuild key positions, remove/move/refresh/diff/Clear without per-key order scans, share one `Arc` envelope per batch, skip keyed-hub partitioning without watchers, and create the rxRust subject lazily on the first `changes_rx()` call. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/source_bookkeeping_costs/` with a tallying key type (equality/hash counters) and a cloning probe.

tasks.title: Operator order mirrors, flip diffs and resort moves
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Replace `Vec::position` order mirrors with key→position maps or append fast paths in `operators/select_unique_cache_changes.rs` helpers, `apply_list_changes.rs`, `cache_dynamic_filter_state*.rs`, lifecycle tracked caches and expiration ordering; make dynamic refilters emit inclusion-flip diffs; make list-shaped sorts emit moves on comparer change/resort (`list_sort_state.rs`, `cache_sort_state_impl.rs`). Group `crates/src/collections/tests/operator_bookkeeping_costs/` with tallying-key counts, the `[1000,2000)→[1001,2001)` flip test and the reverse-5 moves test.

tasks.title: Tree, join and group costs; join-many and tree leaks; benchmarks
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Align tree children once per parent per batch with position maps (`tree/stream_ext.rs`), use sets/maps instead of rebuilt orders and `iter().any` in joins (`join/*`), index group membership in live cache grouping, free join-many groups on left removal (`join/affected_key.rs`), break tree parent cycles on disposal (`tree/node.rs`). Add Criterion benches `crates/benches/joins.rs`, `tree.rs` and `sort_and_page.rs` registered in `crates/Cargo.toml`. Group `crates/src/collections/tests/relation_operator_costs/` with counter-based scaling checks and leak probes.

sprints.title: API hygiene, rustdoc, CI, consumer scenarios, docs and changelog

tasks.title: must_use, Debug, non_exhaustive errors and small API gaps
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Apply HYG-1.1-1.3 across `crates/src/` (attributes, `Debug` impls that snapshot under short lock holds, `#[non_exhaustive]` on the three error enums only, `CompositeSubscription` methods, `DisposeWith` impls, `DisposeBag::clear/len`, `EventStream: Clone`, `EventBus::emit` without `T: Clone`, `Signal: Default`), and fix any call sites in tests, benches, doc examples and `doc-examples` that the new `#[must_use]` flags. Add the integration test `crates/tests/api_hygiene.rs` asserting `Debug` output, the new methods and `#[non_exhaustive]` matching with a wildcard.

tasks.title: Full rustdoc and docs.rs metadata
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Write rustdoc for every public item (modules, types, traits, methods, fields, variants), a crate-root overview linking the guide in `docs/`, set `missing_docs = "warn"` for the crate, and add `documentation` and `[package.metadata.docs.rs] all-features = true` to `crates/Cargo.toml`. Prefer short runnable examples on central APIs (they run as doctests).

tasks.title: MSRV, wasm test and macOS CI jobs
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Extend `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with an MSRV job (Rust 1.95: check and test `rayx_reactive`), a wasm job that installs `wasm-bindgen-cli` and runs the wasm-annotated tests on `wasm32-unknown-unknown` (configure `CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUNNER=wasm-bindgen-test-runner` with Node), and a macOS test job. Locally verify the MSRV build; the green CI run is a manual check.

tasks.title: Consumer scenarios and collections public-API test
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Add `crates/tests/consumer_scenarios.rs` implementing SCN-1.1-1.4 through the public API only (no consumer repository): keyed virtualized list binding with a worker writer and a channel-marshalled UI model, tree view binding with expansion state, foreground observers under worker writes, bounded feed, form validation driving a command, and property-grid style aggregate mirrors. Add `crates/tests/collections_public_api.rs` exercising every collection extension trait and observable wrapper through `rayx_reactive::collections::prelude`.

tasks.title: Docs reflect final behavior; changelog with migration notes
tasks.descriptionMarkdown: Review README and every `docs/*.md` chapter against the final behavior (delivery ordering, contention errors and policies, scheduler, interop without adapters, window responses, index contract, async cancellation, aggregates), remove stale limitation notes and update example assertions; write `CHANGELOG.md` with an "Unreleased" section listing every behavior change, breaking change (new error variants, `#[non_exhaustive]`, generic stream errors, `#[must_use]`, updated pinned tests) and new API with migration notes; update `.claude/skills/rayx-reactive/` references for the new APIs.
